capability: Neighbours nudge each other to agree, no central boss
title: Seven opinions, one line.

hook.picture: Close: seven pods in a ring around the whale, each holding up a different number chip. The whale waits for a boss pod. None comes.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: Seven teams sent seven numbers, and nobody owns the answer.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: an operations lead before the board meeting

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: this ring is one of many. Three times, every 2 beats, then 1, then half, a boss pod is called in, gets swamped by chips, and leaves.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Everyone waits for one boss to decide.

stakes.body: The meeting stalls, someone picks a number by rank, and the rest stop reporting honestly.

solution_hint: Let each one check with its neighbours.

metaphor.body: Seven pods sit in a ring, each joined to its neighbours. Every beat each nudges toward the others, and the ring settles into one line without a boss.

steps.picture: Each pod links to its two neighbours by a short join. Each compares its chip with theirs; the gap shows as a raw sienna stretch on the join.
steps.words: Let each one check with its neighbours.
steps.sound: Two tones per join, beating by the gap.

steps.picture: Every beat, each pod nudges its number a little toward its neighbours. The stretches shrink together, all at once, with no centre.
steps.words: Each nudges toward its neighbours. Again.
steps.sound: The beats slow together on every join.

steps.picture: Push-in on one stubborn pair: their stretch shrinks last. The whale rings it, and it closes.
steps.sound: Last beating pair settles to unison.

steps.picture: The joins settle teal; the ring becomes one smooth closed line. A label slides onto the arrows: diffusion.
steps.words: Step by step agreeing is called diffusion.
steps.sound: A soft bell for the closed ring.

real_case.claim: Planned explainer, not a run: "Sheaf Diffusion: How Local Data Learns to Agree. Seven sensors disagree, and one equation makes them consistent without a central boss."

honest_limit.picture: Push to the settled ring: all seven chips show one number. The board pod outside reads it and still answers ✕. They agreed on a wrong number.
honest_limit.words: All seven agree. All seven are wrong.

not_this.body: Agreement is not the same as truth.

ending_pattern.body: Seven clashing chips slide together and the ring of pods closes into one smooth line around the whale, then a checker compares it against the books.
ending_pattern.callback: The seven clashing pods of bar 1, in the same ring and framing, are now joined by one settled line.

end_belief.body: Let neighbours agree. Then check the answer.

sound.signature: Seven tones that drift toward each other until they ring as one chord.
sound.problem_motif: Seven tones held apart, an uneasy cluster.

score_self.reason: A boss-less ring is a vivid leadership picture, and the limit (agree but wrong) honours caution T5. But it is an Illustration, and the ending still celebrates agreement right after the limit.
